prose: Project EVE has Claude play multiplayer space games, with transcripts of agents in a saboteur-hunt scenario where aligned agents accuse a suspect, and the saboteur argues publicly while reasoning privately about deflecting blame. The page is long; this note rests on the opening excerpt.
highlights: Claude agents play an MMORPG with hidden saboteurs
Shows public messages versus private reasoning
Deception and cooperation are the focus
basis: Only the opening excerpt was reviewed
